stepBody: See image. Only type what is in the blank, do not include what is provided. Do not use spaces unless absolutely necessary. Please use double quotes (" "), instead of single quotes (' '). If you are utilizing the table, please use the numbers in order.##figure3.gif##

figureAlts.figure3.gif: The image shows a table and a fill-in-the-blank code block related to generating a test statistic under the null hypothesis. The table has columns Elevation and Specimen Length, with data: Row 1: High, 12.3; Row 2: Low, 13.1; Row 3: High, 12.0. Below the table, part (d) asks to fill in the blanks in a code block. The code defines a function one_simulation. Inside, shuffled_labels is set to flies with a method and column name as blanks. shuffled_flies is set to flies.with_columns with two blanks. grouped is set to shuffled_flies with a method and three blanks. means is set to grouped.column with 'Specimen length mean'. statistic is set to a blank, and the function returns statistic.
